vehicleFile.title: Vehicle file
vehicleFile.subtitle: Fuel, running costs, repairs, EMI, documents, accidents and fines for each company vehicle
vehicleFile.noRight: The vehicle file needs logistics rights. Ask Admin.
vehicleFile.emptyBody: Add the company's vehicles on Vehicles and drivers; their file opens here.
vehicleFile.docNote: An expired document blocks the vehicle from new trips unless Admin overrides.

notes.fuel: Record each fill with the odometer; full-tank fills give km per litre over time.
notes.repairs: Service by km or months, repairs and parts. Breakdowns and accident repairs are kept apart from routine service.
notes.running: Tolls and FASTag, parking, driver bata, loading and unloading, washing, tyres. Link each to a trip where possible.
notes.loan: EMI, insurance premium and road tax payments for this vehicle.
notes.fines: Traffic challans with the date; the driver at the time comes from the trip log.
notes.accidents: Date, place, damage, police FIR or GD number, insurance claim and amount recovered, in the note.

vehicleFile.addHelp: Entries are never edited or deleted; a mistake is corrected with a new entry.
vehicleFile.docHelp: The earlier entry is kept in the history; the newest one counts for trips.
